## MGIT Successfully Organizes ICASPACE-2025: A Global Gathering of Experts in Signal Processing and Communication Engineering

News Date : 01 Feb 2025News ReportHyderabad, India – January 30-31, 2025:The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Hyderabad, successfully hosted the3rd International Conference on Advances in Signal Processing and Communication Engineering (ICASPACE-2025)on30th and 31st January 2025. The conference brought together leading academicians, researchers, and industry professionals worldwide to discuss cutting-edge innovations inElectronics and Communication Engineering.A Global ParticipationICASPACE-2025 received an overwhelming response, with221 research paperssubmitted from across the globe, including contributions from countries such asthe USA, UAE, Japan, UK, Spain, Greece, and India. The conference served as a platform for exchanging knowledge and fostering collaborations in emerging fields ofsignal processing, machine learning, and communication technologies.Inaugural Session and Keynote SpeakersThe conference washeld in hybrid mode, allowing participants to engage both online via theWebex platformand physically at MGIT. The inaugural session featured distinguished guests and keynote speakers, including:Resource PersonsDr. N. Sudarshan Rao, Professor,Penn State Behrend, Erie, USADr. A K Singh,Scientist-G & Project Director, DLRLDr. Yatindra Nath Singh,Professor (HAG), Indian Institute of Technology, KanpurDr. Aravind Sharma,Professor, NIT KurukshetraDr. Durgesh Mishra,Director and Professor (SCSIT), Symbiosis University of Applied Science, IndoreProf. Samrat Sabat,University of HyderabadProf. K C James Raju,University of HyderabadThese experts delivered insightful talks onemerging trends in signal processing, AI-driven communication technologies, cybersecurity in communication systems, and high-speed communication networks.Organizing TeamPatronsSmt. Hyderabad, India – January 30-31, 2025:The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Hyderabad, successfully hosted the3rd International Conference on Advances in Signal Processing and Communication Engineering (ICASPACE-2025)on30th and 31st January 2025. The conference brought together leading academicians, researchers, and industry professionals worldwide to discuss cutting-edge innovations inElectronics and Communication Engineering.

## A Global Participation

ICASPACE-2025 received an overwhelming response, with221 research paperssubmitted from across the globe, including contributions from countries such asthe USA, UAE, Japan, UK, Spain, Greece, and India. The conference served as a platform for exchanging knowledge and fostering collaborations in emerging fields ofsignal processing, machine learning, and communication technologies.

## Inaugural Session and Keynote Speakers

The conference washeld in hybrid mode, allowing participants to engage both online via theWebex platformand physically at MGIT. The inaugural session featured distinguished guests and keynote speakers, including:

## Resource Persons

- Dr. N. Sudarshan Rao, Professor,Penn State Behrend, Erie, USA
- Dr. A K Singh,Scientist-G & Project Director, DLRL
- Dr. Yatindra Nath Singh,Professor (HAG), Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur
- Dr. Aravind Sharma,Professor, NIT Kurukshetra
- Dr. Durgesh Mishra,Director and Professor (SCSIT), Symbiosis University of Applied Science, Indore
- Prof. Samrat Sabat,University of Hyderabad
- Prof. K C James Raju,University of Hyderabad
These experts delivered insightful talks onemerging trends in signal processing, AI-driven communication technologies, cybersecurity in communication systems, and high-speed communication networks.

## Convenors

- Dr. T. R. Vijaya Lakshmi,Associate Professor, ECE, MGIT
- Mr. D. V. S. Nagendra Kumar,Assistant Professor, ECE, MGIT
- Dr. Y. Praveen Kumar Reddy,Assistant Professor, ECE, MGIT

## Conclusion

The two-day international conferencesuccessfully concluded with groundbreaking discussionson the latest technological advancements insignal processing and communication engineering. ICASPACE-2025 continues to establish MGIT as ahub for research and innovation, fostering global collaborations and knowledge-sharing.
For more details, visit the official website:https://icaspace-ece-mgit.com/
